projects.title: E-commerce Backend
projects.description: Design and developed a scalable backend supporting fast product search, secure transactions, and seamless payment processing for an e-commerce platform, with Spring Boot, Lombok, JPA, Spring Security, MySQL.
highlights: Designed and built a microservices-based REST API backend following test-driven development (TDD).
Enhanced product search with OpenSearch ElasticSearch and improved performance via AWS Redis cache.
Implemented secure access with Bcrypt encryption, role-based access, JWT for session management, and Oauth2 authentication.
Integrated Razorpay and Stripe payment gateways exercising the Strategy pattern with webhooks.
Deployed on AWS Elastic Beanstalk with AWS RDS and ensured reliability through robust logging and monitoring.

projects.title: Open Source: flickpicker
projects.description: Contributed to an open-source project, flickpicker, template for an application for Discord movie night that can be used for a voting system. So that users can vote on through Discord, possibly Titch, or through the app/website itself
highlights: Implemented the backend using Express.js and json format database for efficient saving and retrieval of movies.
Integrated with in-browser caching for fast access to frequently used data.
Real-time vote count updates using optimistic UI updates and async backend updates.
Optimized performance by implementing pagination and lazy loading for large datasets.

projects.title: Movie Revenue Prediction
projects.description: A machine learning project that forecasts a movie's box office earnings, leveraging metadata (budget, cast, genre), audience sentiment (reviews, social media trends) backed by CRISP-DM methodology.
highlights: Integrating data from IMDb, TMDb, Box Office Mojo, and social platforms to generate insights for studios and investors.
Utilizing NLP-based script analysis to identify key revenue predictors from movie dialogues and descriptions.
Implementing models like Random Forest, XGBoost, and deep learning to improve prediction accuracy.
Interactive dashboard for exploring prediction insights using streamlit

projects.title: GatorCan
projects.description: Full-stack scalable educational platform enabling seamless course management, assignment submissions, and real-time collaboration for students and instructors, in Golang (gin), React.js, and SQLite.
highlights: Designed and built a robust backend with Golang, ensuring efficient user management and course enrollment workflows.
Implemented a structured weekly schedule view and streamlined assignment submissions with AWS S3 storage.
Developed real-time messaging channels for student-instructor and peer discussions within courses.
Integrated AWS ECS for backend deployment and explored AWS RDS as a scalable database solution.
Developed and integrated AI/NLP-based features for personalized course recommendations and notes summarization.

projects.title: HiringInUSA
projects.description: SEO-optimized job tracking and curation platform built as a production-grade Next.js application to practice scalable frontend architecture, metadata optimization, and analytics-driven performance monitoring.
highlights: Designed and developed a fully responsive Next.js application with dynamic routing and structured metadata for improved search visibility.
Implemented modular UI architecture using Material UI, ensuring reusable components and scalable layout patterns.
Built structured data pipelines to organize, categorize, and display curated job listings efficiently.
Integrated analytics tooling to monitor traffic patterns and optimize performance using Core Web Vitals principles.
Engineered ad-ready layout infrastructure with feature-flag controls to support future monetization without architectural changes.

projects.title: UF Climate Data Platform
projects.description: Production-grade weather data fusion platform that aggregates NASA POWER satellite data and CHIRPS precipitation records into optimized Zarr stores, featuring a Next.js admin dashboard for multi-point downloads with advanced temporal caching and async query optimization.
highlights: Engineered a distributed data pipeline that ingests NASA POWER (MERRA-2, SYN1deg) and CHIRPS precipitation datasets into Zarr format, enabling efficient temporal-first queries across 40+ years of historical climate data.

Architected a Python backend with async data fetchers implementing intelligent time-slice caching and LRU eviction, achieving 83-94x performance improvements for multi-location queries through batched parallel processing.

Built a full-stack Next.js application with dynamic routing and structured metadata for shapefile-based multi-point downloads, CLI tools, and RESTful APIs supporting real-world agricultural weather analysis.

Integrated email notification systems and robust error handling for long-running batch operations, with comprehensive validation workflows covering data availability across historical (1981+) and real-time datasets.

Optimized data retrieval using xarray/fsspec with temporal-domain caching strategies, reducing redundant S3 requests from O(n) per location to O(1) per date range, enabling scalable multi-point agricultural queries.

projects.title: DSSAT-RAG
projects.description: Production-grade agricultural data intelligence platform built with Next.js to automate DSSAT simulation workflows, enable intelligent data retrieval through RAG, and empower farmers with AI-driven insights from crop modeling outputs.
highlights: Engineered end-to-end automation pipeline integrating Google Drive monitoring, DSSAT/Pythia output detection, and chunked data ingestion into RAG vector database for efficient agricultural knowledge retrieval.

Architected responsive Next.js chatbot UI with Material-UI components supporting real-time farmer queries against processed simulation data with full Markdown rendering and syntax-highlighted outputs.
Designed modular service-oriented architecture with TypeScript strict typing, API abstraction layer, and production-ready error handling for scalable multi-user agricultural platform.
Implemented n8n-based workflow automation orchestrating file monitoring, Google Drive integration, and batch processing pipelines to reduce manual data handling overhead.
Built semantically-aware data chunking and vector embeddings infrastructure to enable contextual agricultural queries across DSSAT crop models, soil parameters, and yield predictions.

projects.title: Agent-as-a-Judge
projects.description: Production-grade LLM evaluation and benchmarking framework built in Python to systematically assess model performance (with and without context) using hybrid scoring (deterministic + LLM-as-a-judge), enabling data-driven decisions between proprietary and local models.
highlights: Designed a modular evaluation pipeline to compare context-aware vs context-free model outputs using structured datasets and parallel inference workflows.
Implemented hybrid scoring architecture combining embedding-based semantic similarity, rule-based validation, and LLM-as-a-judge for multi-dimensional evaluation.
Developed metric framework covering correctness, faithfulness, relevance, conciseness, and context gain to quantify real impact of retrieval augmentation.
Built extensible benchmarking system to evaluate multiple models (OpenAI, Gemini, local LLMs) with reproducible experiments and leaderboard-style reporting.
Engineered structured evaluation prompts with JSON outputs to ensure deterministic scoring and minimize judge bias and hallucinated evaluations.
Integrated experiment tracking, logging, and batch evaluation pipelines to support scalable testing and iterative model improvements.
Designed pluggable architecture for swapping embedding models, LLM providers, and evaluation strategies without refactoring core pipeline.
